title: Working Shifts But Want to Lose Weight? Here's How to Work With a Schedule That Keeps Changing
intro: Yes, you can still lose weight even if you work shifts. The key is not what time you eat, but how much and what you eat in one 'work day' of yours.

sections.h: Count your 'day' from when you wake up
sections.p: Don't follow the wall clock. Count your day from the time you wake up. First main meal after waking, another one in the middle of your shift, and a light snack if you're hungry before sleeping. The total you eat in 24 hours is what matters most.

This is when your body is most tired. It's very easy to grab biscuits, sweet bread or packet drinks. Prepare a protein packed meal in advance, for example boiled eggs, chicken or tofu. Drink plain water first before looking for a snack.

You don't have to avoid the canteen. Take half a plate of rice, one protein lauk and vegetables. Choose grilled, boiled or soy sauce dishes more often than flour-battered fried ones. Take a little gravy on the side.
Lack of sleep makes hunger and sweet cravings go up. Darken your room and keep your phone a bit further away. Avoid coffee within about 6 hours before your bedtime.
No need to exercise every day. 2-3 sessions a week, 20-30 minutes, on your off days or before your shift is enough. A 10-minute walk after meals also helps a lot.

action: Write down this week's shift schedule and mark your main meal times.
Bring one protein packed meal for every night shift.
Replace one midnight sweet drink with plain water or tea without sugar.
Pick 2 off days for a 20-minute workout.
Put up dark curtains or use an eye mask for daytime sleep.
myth: Many people believe eating after midnight turns straight into fat. Actually, the total you eat in the whole day matters more than the clock, so focus on portions and food choices.

faq.q: Do I need breakfast when I come home from a night shift in the morning?
faq.a: If you're hungry, eat something light with protein so you sleep better. For example bread with egg, or porridge with chicken. Avoid eating something very heavy just before sleeping.

faq.q: Can I drink coffee to stay awake?
faq.a: Yes, but cut down on sugar and condensed milk. Drink it early in your shift, not near the end, so it doesn't disturb your sleep after work.

faq.q: How fast can I lose weight?
faq.a: A realistic target is about 0.5-1 kg a week. Weeks when your schedule changes a lot may be slower, and that's normal. Being consistent is more important than being perfect.
